purpose: Tracking-feasibility screening of source state trajectories in the target simulator, before any training.
authorized: walker2d-morph B1/B2 if its B0 passes and the hopper regression passes
source_selection: complete source trajectories (known reset start, recorded terminal/timeout end, no continuity gap) whose first observation has no clipped velocity; fixed-seed sampling without replacement; all are used if fewer than 500
B0_rule: every target segment reaches its recorded end, terminal labels match at every step, and every step has normalized residual <= 8.4e-4; the value is the gate fixed for hopper in v14b and is adopted unchanged for walker2d before any walker2d result exists
normalization: sample SD (ddof=1) of each coordinate of the task's target current observations + v13 std_epsilon, float64; residual is L2
residual_reference_note: descriptive only: share of B2 steps with normalized residual <= 0.0840 (the v13 hopper filter threshold); not part of any rule
B_interpretation: untrackable if median survival <200 and fraction(T/L>=0.8)<0.1; trackable if fraction>=0.5; otherwise uncertain; one-step greedy only
failure_policy: No retry. Any exception, NaN/Inf or hash mismatch stops and keeps the evidence. A failed hopper regression stops before walker2d.
